DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City DILG OPINION No. 99 s. 2022 SEP 16 2022 Mr. JOSE EFREN J. ORTEGA Denieortega61@gmail.com Dear Mr. Ortega: This refers to your letter dated I August 2022 requesting for this Department's legal opinion concerning the solicitations made to Producer & Exporter Corporation by Sangguniang Barangay Member Anthony M. Juanton, Barangay Ayala, Zamboanga City; and (2) Memorandum dated 5 August 2022 from Director Paisal O. Abutazil, DILG-RegionaI Office No. IX, forwarding the aforesaid letter for Central Office's legal opinion concerning the propriety of action by herein concerned Barangay Officials. As represented in the subject letter, the solicitation letter in question mentioned of the Five Thousand Eight Hundred pesos (Php5,800.OO) as the registration fee that would cover only the training and souvenir kit, lunch and snacks during the five-day activity and does not include the cost of accommodation and airfare though cash advances were released for all expenses that could have had incurred by the Barangay Officials who attended the activity (Celebration of the 27th National Children's Month and the 30th Anniversary of the U.N. Convention of the Rights of the Child" held on November 18 to 22, 2019 at SMX Convention Center in Pasig City. Premised from the foregoing, arose your query as to the propriety of the action demonstrated by herein concerned Sangguniang Barangay Member. In reply thereto, attention is respectfully directed to pertinent provisions of Republic Act No. 6713, otherwise known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, thus: "Section 7. Prohibited Acts and Transactions. - In addition to acts and omissions of public officials and employees now prescribed in the Constitution and existing laws, the following shall constitute prohibited acts and transactions of any public official and employee and are hereby declared to be unlawful: Xxx (d) Solicitation or acceptance of gifts. - Public officials and employees shall not solicit or accept, directly or indirectly, any gift, gratuity, favor, entertainment, loan or anything of monetary value from any person in the course of their official duties or in connection with any operation being regulated by, or any transaction which may be affected by the functions of their office "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Xxx The Ombudsman shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this subsection, including pertinent reporting and disclosure requirements. Nothing in this Act shall be construed to restrict or prohibit any educational, scientific or cultural exchange programs subject to national security requirements." (Emphasis supplied) Accordingly, public officials such as sangguniang barangay members are prohibited from soliciting or accepting favors or anything of monetary value in the course of their official duties. Hence, it is respectfully opined that the action of herein concerned Sangguniang Barangay member appears to be violative of the foregoing provisions. Notwithstanding, we would like to reiterate that the opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations narrated in the letter and our appreciation of the same, and is being issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of more competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: i" GAN Undersec ry for Local Governmen OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam Dir. PAISAL O. ABUTAZIL Regional Director, DILG-Region IX President Corazon C. Aquino Regional Government Center Barangay Balintawak, Pagadian City Page 2 of 2
